QuestInfo.name: Traces of the Black Mage
QuestInfo.1: The Omens are guarding the Black Mage's Antechamber. They seem to be remnants of the Black Mage's darkness. Eliminate all Omens to enter his Antechamber.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated all the Omens blocking the Black Mage's Antechamber. He has long since left this place, but his traces linger.

1.0: Now that I am here, I remember that day more clearly. But remembering is the last thing I want. I need to leave, to move on.
